parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State what is meant by specific acoustic impedance.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
A parallel beam of ultrasound of intensity $I_0$ is incident normally on the boundary between two media, as shown in Fig. 5.1.

{{figure:figure_5_1.png}}

Fig. 5.1

The media have specific acoustic impedances $Z_1$ and $Z_2$.

The intensity of the ultrasound beam transmitted across the boundary is $I_{\text{T}}$.

Explain the significance of the magnitudes of $Z_1$ and of $Z_2$ on the ratio $I_{\text{T}} / I_0$.

stem: Ultrasound may be used to obtain information about internal body structures.
